```{r club-engagement}
clubs$Attendance_Rate   <- round(clubs$Avg_Attendance / clubs$Members * 100, 1)
clubs$Consistency_Rate  <- round(clubs$Regular_Participants / clubs$Members * 100, 1)
clubs$Interaction_Score <- clubs$Competition_Entries + clubs$Workshops_Attended

clubs$Engagement_Score <- round(
  0.30 * clubs$Attendance_Rate +
  0.30 * clubs$Consistency_Rate +
  0.20 * (clubs$Interaction_Score / max(clubs$Interaction_Score) * 100) +
  0.20 * (clubs$Feedback_Rating / 5 * 100), 1)

ranked <- clubs[order(-clubs$Engagement_Score),
                c("Club_Name","Members","Attendance_Rate","Consistency_Rate","Engagement_Score")]

print(ranked, row.names = FALSE)
```

hour_value   <- 50
member_value <- 200

done <- subset(events, Status == "Completed")

done$Total_Cost    <- done$Money_Spent_INR + done$Volunteer_Hours * hour_value
done$Total_Benefit <- done$Sponsorship_INR + done$Ticket_Revenue_INR +
                      done$New_Memberships * member_value
done$ROI_Percent   <- round((done$Total_Benefit - done$Total_Cost) /
                             done$Total_Cost * 100, 1)
done$Crowd_vs_Expected <- round(done$Actual_Attendance /
                                done$Expected_Attendance * 100, 0)

#financial-metrices
hour_value   <- 50
member_value <- 200

done <- subset(events, Status == "Completed")

done$Total_Cost    <- done$Money_Spent_INR + done$Volunteer_Hours * hour_value
done$Total_Revenue <- done$Sponsorship_INR + done$Ticket_Revenue_INR
done$Total_Benefit <- done$Total_Revenue + done$New_Memberships * member_value

done$Financial_ROI          <- round((done$Total_Benefit - done$Total_Cost) / done$Total_Cost * 100, 1)
done$Cost_per_Attendee      <- round(done$Total_Cost / done$Actual_Attendance, 1)
done$Revenue_per_Attendee   <- round(done$Total_Revenue / done$Actual_Attendance, 1)
done$Budget_Utilization     <- round(done$Money_Spent_INR / done$Planned_Budget_INR * 100, 1)
done$Sponsorship_Share      <- round(done$Sponsorship_INR / done$Total_Cost * 100, 1)
done$Break_Even_Attendance  <- ceiling((done$Total_Cost - done$Sponsorship_INR) / done$Ticket_Price_INR)

fin_table <- done[, c("Event_Name","Financial_ROI","Cost_per_Attendee","Revenue_per_Attendee",
                      "Budget_Utilization","Sponsorship_Share","Break_Even_Attendance","Paid_Attendees")]
print(fin_table, row.names = FALSE)


#financial graph
par(mfrow = c(2, 3), mar = c(5, 4, 3, 1))

# 1. Financial ROI (%)
barplot(done$Financial_ROI, names.arg = done$Event_Name,
        col = c("darkorange", "seagreen"), main = "Financial ROI (%)",
        ylab = "ROI %", ylim = c(0, max(done$Financial_ROI) * 1.2))

# 2. Cost vs revenue per attendee
barplot(rbind(done$Cost_per_Attendee, done$Revenue_per_Attendee),
        beside = TRUE, names.arg = done$Event_Name,
        col = c("tomato", "seagreen"), main = "Cost vs Revenue per Attendee",
        ylab = "INR per attendee",
        legend.text = c("Cost", "Revenue"), args.legend = list(x = "topleft"))

# 3. Budget utilization (%)
barplot(done$Budget_Utilization, names.arg = done$Event_Name,
        col = "steelblue", main = "Budget Utilization (%)",
        ylab = "% of planned budget", ylim = c(0, 110))
abline(h = 100, lty = 2, col = "red")   # red line = full budget

# 4. Sponsorship contribution (%)
barplot(done$Sponsorship_Share, names.arg = done$Event_Name,
        col = "purple", main = "Sponsorship Contribution (%)",
        ylab = "% of total cost", ylim = c(0, 100))

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))




#Student engagement matrix
# Event-level
done$Reg_to_Attendance <- round(done$Actual_Attendance / done$Registered_Students * 100, 1)
done$Repeat_Rate       <- round(done$Returning_Participants / done$Previous_Participants * 100, 1)

# Club-level
clubs$Active_Member_Rate  <- round(clubs$Regular_Participants / clubs$Members * 100, 1)
clubs$Membership_Growth   <- round((clubs$Members - clubs$Previous_Members) / clubs$Previous_Members * 100, 1)
clubs$Retention_Rate      <- round(clubs$Retained_Members / clubs$Previous_Members * 100, 1)
clubs$Cross_Club_Rate     <- round(clubs$Multi_Club_Members / clubs$Members * 100, 1)

event_eng <- done[, c("Event_Name","Reg_to_Attendance","Repeat_Rate")]
club_eng  <- clubs[order(-clubs$Retention_Rate),
                   c("Club_Name","Active_Member_Rate","Membership_Growth","Retention_Rate","Cross_Club_Rate")]
print(event_eng, row.names = FALSE)
print(club_eng,  row.names = FALSE)


#graph

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))





#quality matrix and event performance score
# Normalise all five components to 0-100
A <- done$Reg_to_Attendance
S <- done$Satisfaction_Rating / 5 * 100
L <- done$Learning_Outcome_Score / 5 * 100
R <- done$Repeat_Rate
C <- pmin(100, done$Total_Revenue / done$Total_Cost * 100)

done$EPS <- round(0.30*A + 0.25*S + 0.20*L + 0.15*R + 0.10*C, 1)

# Popularity index and networking
social_pa <- done$Social_Media_Engagements / done$Actual_Attendance
social_idx <- social_pa / max(social_pa) * 100
done$Popularity_Index <- round((pmin(100, done$Actual_Attendance / done$Expected_Attendance * 100) + social_idx) / 2, 1)
done$Networking_per_Attendee <- round(done$Networking_Connections / done$Actual_Attendance, 2)

quality_table <- done[, c("Event_Name","Satisfaction_Rating","Learning_Outcome_Score",
                          "Networking_per_Attendee","Popularity_Index","EPS")]
print(quality_table, row.names = FALSE)

#graph
par(mfrow = c(2, 3), mar = c(5, 4, 3, 1))

# 1. Satisfaction vs learning outcome (out of 5)
barplot(rbind(done$Satisfaction_Rating, done$Learning_Outcome_Score),
        beside = TRUE, names.arg = done$Event_Name,
        col = c("steelblue", "orange"), main = "Satisfaction vs Learning (out of 5)",
        ylim = c(0, 5.5),
        legend.text = c("Satisfaction", "Learning"),
        args.legend = list(x = "topright", cex = 0.8))

# 2. Networking per attendee
barplot(done$Networking_per_Attendee, names.arg = done$Event_Name,
        col = "purple", main = "Networking Connections per Attendee",
        ylab = "Connections")

# 3. Popularity index
barplot(done$Popularity_Index, names.arg = done$Event_Name,
        col = "seagreen", main = "Event Popularity Index",
        ylab = "Score (0-100)", ylim = c(0, 110))

# 4. Event Performance Score
barplot(done$EPS, names.arg = done$Event_Name,
        col = c("darkorange", "seagreen"), main = "Event Performance Score (EPS)",
        ylab = "Score (0-100)", ylim = c(0, 100))

# 5. What makes up each EPS (stacked)
contrib <- rbind(Attendance = 0.30 * A, Satisfaction = 0.25 * S,
                 Learning = 0.20 * L, Repeat = 0.15 * R, Cost_Eff = 0.10 * C)
barplot(contrib, names.arg = done$Event_Name,
        col = c("steelblue", "orange", "seagreen", "purple", "tomato"),
        main = "EPS Breakdown by Component", ylab = "EPS points",
        legend.text = rownames(contrib), args.legend = list(x = "bottomright", cex = 0.7))

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))



ev    <- read.csv("events_master.csv")
seg   <- read.csv("event_segments.csv")
enrol <- read.csv("enrolment.csv")
head(ev)
head(seg)
head(enrol)

hour_value <- 50; member_value <- 200

ev$Total_Cost    <- ev$Money_Spent_INR + ev$Volunteer_Hours * hour_value
ev$Total_Revenue <- ev$Sponsorship_INR + ev$Ticket_Revenue_INR
ev$Total_Benefit <- ev$Total_Revenue + ev$New_Members * member_value
ev$ROI               <- round((ev$Total_Benefit - ev$Total_Cost) / ev$Total_Cost * 100, 1)
ev$Cost_per_Attendee <- round(ev$Total_Cost / ev$Attended, 1)
ev$Attendance_Rate   <- round(ev$Attended / ev$Registered * 100, 1)
ev$Impact_Score      <- round(0.5 * ev$Avg_Satisfaction / 5 * 100 +
                              0.5 * pmin(100, ev$Attendance_Rate), 1)

print(ev[, c("Event_Name","Event_Type","ROI","Cost_per_Attendee",
             "Attendance_Rate","Avg_Satisfaction","Impact_Score")], row.names = FALSE)
             

             
drivers  <- c("Money_Spent_INR","Marketing_Spend_INR","Duration_Days",
              "Held_On_Weekend","Free_Entry","Collaborating_Clubs")
outcomes <- c("Attended","Attendance_Rate","Avg_Satisfaction")

# Spearman (rank) correlation, so Daksh's huge size doesn't dominate
driver_cor <- round(cor(ev[, drivers], ev[, outcomes], method = "spearman"), 2)
print(driver_cor)

m_att <- lm(Attendance_Rate ~ Held_On_Weekend + Free_Entry, data = ev)
m_sat <- lm(Avg_Satisfaction ~ Attendance_Rate + Collaborating_Clubs, data = ev)
summary(m_att)
summary(m_sat)

par(mfrow = c(2, 2), mar = c(7, 4, 3, 1))
plot(log10(ev$Marketing_Spend_INR), log10(ev$Attended), pch = 16, col = "steelblue",
     xlab = "log10 marketing spend", ylab = "log10 attendance", main = "Marketing vs Attendance")
abline(lm(log10(Attended) ~ log10(Marketing_Spend_INR), data = ev), col = "red")

boxplot(Attendance_Rate ~ Held_On_Weekend, data = ev, names = c("Weekday", "Weekend"),
        col = c("orange", "seagreen"), ylab = "Attendance rate (%)", main = "Weekend vs Weekday")
boxplot(Avg_Satisfaction ~ Event_Type, data = ev, las = 2, col = "grey85",
        ylab = "Rating", main = "Satisfaction by Event Type")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))



impact_cutoff <- 80

ev$Decision <- ifelse(ev$ROI >= 0 & ev$Impact_Score >= impact_cutoff, "Scale up",
               ifelse(ev$ROI <  0 & ev$Impact_Score >= impact_cutoff, "Fund for impact",
               ifelse(ev$ROI >= 0, "Fix experience", "Rework")))

multiplier <- c("Scale up" = 1.2, "Fund for impact" = 1.0, "Fix experience" = 0.9, "Rework" = 0.7)
raw <- ev$Money_Spent_INR * unname(multiplier[ev$Decision])
ev$Indicative_Budget <- round(raw / sum(raw) * sum(ev$Money_Spent_INR), -2)  # same total pool

print(ev[, c("Event_Name","ROI","Impact_Score","Decision","Money_Spent_INR","Indicative_Budget")],
      row.names = FALSE)
print(table(ev$Decision))

type_sum <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(ev, ev$Event_Type), function(g) data.frame(
  Events = nrow(g), Spend = sum(g$Money_Spent_INR), Attended = sum(g$Attended),
  ROI = round((sum(g$Total_Benefit) - sum(g$Total_Cost)) / sum(g$Total_Cost) * 100, 1),
  Satisfaction = round(sum(g$Avg_Satisfaction * g$Attended) / sum(g$Attended), 2))))
type_sum$Spend_Share      <- round(type_sum$Spend / sum(type_sum$Spend) * 100, 1)
type_sum$Attendance_Share <- round(type_sum$Attended / sum(type_sum$Attended) * 100, 1)
print(type_sum)

cols <- c("Scale up"="seagreen", "Fund for impact"="steelblue", "Fix experience"="orange", "Rework"="tomato")
plot(ev$Impact_Score, ev$ROI, pch = 16, cex = 1.6, col = cols[ev$Decision],
     xlab = "Impact Score", ylab = "Financial ROI (%)", main = "Event Decision Map")
abline(h = 0, v = impact_cutoff, lty = 2)
text(ev$Impact_Score, ev$ROI, ev$Event_ID, pos = 3, cex = 0.7)
legend("bottomright", legend = names(cols), col = cols, pch = 16)





seg <- merge(seg, ev[, c("Event_ID","Event_Type","Cost_per_Attendee")], by = "Event_ID")
seg$Cost_Allocated <- seg$Cost_per_Attendee * seg$Attended
seg$Sat_Weighted   <- seg$Avg_Satisfaction * seg$Attended

summarise_by <- function(by_col) {
  g <- aggregate(seg[, c("Registered","Attended","New_Members","Cost_Allocated","Sat_Weighted")],
                 by = list(Group = seg[[by_col]]), FUN = sum)
  e <- aggregate(enrol["Enrolled"], by = list(Group = enrol[[by_col]]), FUN = sum)
  g <- merge(g, e, by = "Group")
  data.frame(Group = g$Group, Enrolled = g$Enrolled, Attended = g$Attended,
    Attendance_Rate         = round(g$Attended / g$Registered * 100, 1),
    Satisfaction            = round(g$Sat_Weighted / g$Attended, 2),
    New_Members_per_100     = round(g$New_Members / g$Attended * 100, 1),
    Attendances_per_Student = round(g$Attended / g$Enrolled, 2),
    Cost_per_Student        = round(g$Cost_Allocated / g$Enrolled, 0))
}
by_year <- summarise_by("Student_Year")
by_prog <- summarise_by("Programme")
print(by_year, row.names = FALSE)
print(by_prog, row.names = FALSE)

# Year x programme participation intensity
att_mat   <- tapply(seg$Attended, list(seg$Student_Year, seg$Programme), sum)
enr_mat   <- tapply(enrol$Enrolled, list(enrol$Student_Year, enrol$Programme), sum)
intensity <- round(att_mat / enr_mat, 2)
rownames(intensity) <- paste("Year", rownames(intensity))
print(intensity)

# Which event types suit which year (satisfaction)
sw <- tapply(seg$Sat_Weighted, list(seg$Student_Year, seg$Event_Type), sum)
aw <- tapply(seg$Attended,     list(seg$Student_Year, seg$Event_Type), sum)
print(round(sw / aw, 2))

par(mfrow = c(2, 2), mar = c(5, 4, 3, 1))
barplot(by_year$Attendances_per_Student, names.arg = paste("Year", by_year$Group),
        col = "steelblue", main = "Attendances per Student by Year", ylab = "Per student")
barplot(by_year$Cost_per_Student, names.arg = paste("Year", by_year$Group),
        col = "orange", main = "Event Cost per Student by Year", ylab = "INR")
barplot(by_prog$Attendances_per_Student, names.arg = by_prog$Group,
        col = "seagreen", main = "Attendances per Student by Programme", ylab = "Per student")
barplot(by_prog$Satisfaction, names.arg = by_prog$Group, ylim = c(0, 5),
        col = "purple", main = "Satisfaction by Programme", ylab = "Rating")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

heatmap(intensity, Rowv = NA, Colv = NA, scale = "none",
        col = heat.colors(12, rev = TRUE), margins = c(8, 6),
        main = "Attendances per Student (Year x Programme)")
